variants.design_question: Does the smallest bounded reduction from the current exponent reduce the right/front convergence while preserving the established wrap silhouette?
Does a moderate reduction create a cleaner termination reflection field without over-inflating the cap or disturbing the confirmed interface hierarchy?
Does a stronger reduction materially improve the termination pinch, and if so does the resulting fuller wrap remain visually controlled?

selection_policy: EXISTING_MACHINE_QA_PASS + native relation ownership/readback/restore PASS → render every passing variant under fixed termination Strip/Grazing/Zebra → visual decision; no lowest-metric automatic winner
boundary: R4.1 varies one existing native Source relation only. The exponent remains Working Source, all meshes remain derived, and no Candidate/Canonical Promotion is authorized.
